chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu al-Hasan al-Isbahani, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The worst of you are the carriers of gossip, the separators between the lovers, the seekers of faults in the righteous, and the fault-finders.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.النَّمِيمَة: Gossip / Carrying tales to cause discord

ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics of the worst people according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes the 'worst' of people through four specific social vices: namimah (gossip), tafreeq (causing discord), ibtigha' al-bara' (seeking faults in the innocent), and mu'aybah (constant fault-finding). This classification highlights how interpersonal corruption undermines community cohesion, a theme central to Shia ethical teachings on maintaining unity (wahdah) and purity of heart. The description of 'seeking faults in the innocent' specifically refers to those who scrutinize the righteous to find minor flaws, thereby justifying criticism and creating division.
